info.description: HRMS Backend API â Enterprise Human Resource Management System

post.description:
Authenticate user by email and password.
Returns access and refresh JWT tokens along with user information.
Generate a new access token using a valid refresh token.

get.description: Fetch details of the currently authenticated user.
Get all company departments.

schema.title: Response List Departments Api V1 Departments Get

post.description: Create a new department (HR / Super Admin only).

get.description: Get all registered office locations for geofencing.

schema.title: Response List Office Locations Api V1 Office Locations Get

post.description: Register a new office location (HR / Super Admin only).

Create a new employee (HR / Super Admin only).
Automatically generates employee code, user login credentials, and initial leave balances.

get.description:
List employees with role-based visibility:
- Super Admin / HR Admin: Company-wide view
- Manager: Direct reports and self
- Employee: Self-only view

Get detailed profile of a specific employee.
Enforces reporting line and self-visibility scoping.

put.description:
Update employee information.
- HR / Super Admin: Can update any field.
- Employee: Can only update phone, address, emergency_contact, and profile_photo_url on their own profile.

post.description: Clock in for today with server-side geofencing and IP validation.
Clock out for today and compute total hours.

get.description: Retrieve monthly attendance history for currently logged-in employee.

post.description: Request attendance regularization for missed or incorrect check-in/out.

put.description: Manager or HR approves or rejects an attendance regularization request.

post.description: Submit a Work From Home attendance request.

get.description: Export attendance records to downloadable Excel workbook.

post.description: Bulk import attendance records from Excel spreadsheet (HR/Admin only).

get.summary: List holidays for a given year
get.description: Retrieve all holidays (mandatory, optional, festival) for the specified year.

post.description: Add a company holiday (HR / Super Admin only).
Employee selects an optional holiday, enforcing the maximum allowed limit per year.

get.description: Get all available leave types in the organization.

post.description: Add a new leave type policy (HR / Super Admin only).

get.description: Retrieve leave balances for the logged-in employee for the given year.

post.description: Submit a leave application with balance and overlap checks.

put.description: Approve a pending leave request and atomically deduct the employee's balance.
Reject a pending leave request with an optional comment.

get.summary: List leave requests with role scoping
get.description: List leave requests with query-level role scoping.
Export leave requests to downloadable Excel (.xlsx).

post.summary: Bulk import leave balances from Excel
post.description: Bulk import/adjust leave balances from Excel spreadsheet (HR/Admin only).
Create a new project (Manager / HR / Admin).

get.description:
List projects visible to user.
- HR / Super Admin: All projects
- Manager / Employee: Projects created by self or where user is a member

schema.title: Response List Projects Api V1 Projects Get

get.description: Get detailed project profile with members and task count.

post.description: Assign an employee to a project (Manager / HR only).
Create a project task and assign it to an employee (Manager / HR only).

get.description: Retrieve all tasks assigned to the currently logged-in employee.
